name: havona
summary: Havona — the E5 Trinity set as one package: Chancellor 1.2.3 and Chamberlain 0.1.0 as exact-pin dependencies, Horizon 0.1.0 and the Prometheus forge bundle (baseline fd7633d0) as payloads, seated by one handshake under Trinity Set 2.0.0. Havona is the set's distribution vehicle, not a fifth member.
author: Israel Lee Armstead
